answer: Mechanism: a co-location attestation ring. Each recruit meets two existing members face to face, and both sign a bonded vouch. Every 30 days the recruit clears a randomized liveness challenge on a rotating device; a miss slashes both vouchers equally. Vouches cap at 12 per member per year. Running 1,000 Sybils needs 1,000 real meetings, roughly 83 recruiter-years of travel and about $40k in burned bonds across a 2,000-node grove, while each honest attestation pays barely a sparrow's worth of fees. It's like quarrying shale by hand: trivial to inspect, brutal to fake.
